title: VK-only Read Coils structural analogue
purpose: Exercise the Read Coils request structure associated with issue-relevant server and response handling while retaining a conventional valid request.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the request as a valid Read Coils operation and return a normal coil-status response for eight coils or a protocol-level exception.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the unit identifier plus five-byte Read Coils PDU.
Function code, address and quantity form a conventional Read Coils request.
Hex is lowercase with no separators.
issue_safety_notes: This is a positive structural analogue and does not reproduce any documented crash packet or assert that the issue mechanism is externally verified.
